title: cardamine hirsuta subsp. puberula
intro: Cardamine hirsuta subsp. puberula, commonly known as hairy bittercress, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Cardamine hirsuta subsp. puberula are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
